subject: OrionData evaluation runbook, success metrics, and risk register
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Mensah <aisha.mensah@oriondata.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@oriondata.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement <procurement@oriondata.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: OrionData eval runbook + proposed success metrics

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and proposed runbook so we can get the POC started without surprises. Please reply with any changes and confirm procurement timing so we can lock resources.

High-level success criteria (please confirm these):
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for 512-token generation on targeted models
- Throughput: sustained 60 requests/sec for embedding + rerank pipeline (burst to 120)
- Quality: retrieval + rerank end-to-end MAP@10 improvement >= 12% vs current baseline
- Cost target: incremental inference cost < $0.015/token average (for the scaled test)

Proposed evaluation plan (4-week):
Week 0 (prework): network allowlist, SOC2 evidence, sample dataset loaded
Week 1: embedding baseline & offline rerank scoring (metrics, stability)
Week 2: online integration in staging, latency/throughput stress tests
Week 3: end-to-end A/B test with a 1% traffic sample, monitoring and sample review
Week 4: results review, signoff & roll-forward plan or rollback criteria

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood technical lead (networking & infra): Ben Carter
- Redwood engagement lead (schedule & coordination): Sofia Ivanova
- Orion evaluation lead (data, acceptance tests): Aisha Mensah

Known risks from call (initial):
1) Network egress / allowlist constraints on Orion side (may block ability to hit hosted endpoints).
2) SOC2 evidence & key management questions for private data sets.
3) Long tail latency on large batches if KV cache not primed.

Immediate asks from Orion: share the evaluation checklist and SOC2 statement — attaching a draft checklist and the runbook worksheet for your review.

Attachments: redwood_eval_checklist.pdf, orion_poc_requirements.xlsx

Next steps (please confirm):
- Orion confirms timeline for procurement (target date for signed SOW)
- Orion verifies IP allowlist window and any required VPN/Direct-Connect steps
- Redwood schedules kickoff (target week of Dec 6)

Thanks — looking forward to getting the test started.

--
Sofia Ivanova
Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
From: Aisha Mensah <aisha.mensah@oriondata.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@oriondata.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@oriondata.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:37:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: OrionData eval runbook + proposed success metrics

Thanks Sofia — good summary. Quick confirmations and one blocker to flag from our infra team.

Confirmations:
- Success criteria above look right to us; we might tighten MAP target after Week 1 once we see baseline numbers.
- Procurement: current target for SOW and PO is week of Dec 13–17 (procurement needs a final SOW to route internally).

Blocker (networking):
Our security team enforces egress allowlists and does not permit direct outbound traffic to SaaS endpoints without a reviewed exception. Two options we can take:
  a) Allowlist the Redwood IP range for the test window (preferred)
  b) Use our private VPC peering/direct-connect (longer lead time)

We also need SOC2 Type II (or equivalent) evidence and a brief note on key management — specifically: can Redwood support a VPC/private deployment with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)?

Attaching our SOC2 questionnaire (orion_soc2.pdf) and a brief note from infra on the allowlist window (internal). If we go the allowlist route we can likely start the week of Dec 6; if we need peering it will push to late Dec.

Aisha
Aisha Mensah
Head of Data Science, OrionData
aisha.mensah@oriondata.ai

Thanks — looping in implementation notes and a mitigation plan for the network constraint.

Mitigation options and impact estimates:
1) Temporary allowlist of Redwood public endpoints (fastest): 1–3 business days to validate once we have IPs and time window. Requires procurement signoff for a test window.
2) Private deployment (VPC peering / Direct Connect): 10–21 business days depending on peering approvals and routing setup. Higher isolation, recommended if production move planned.
3) VPN tunnel to an isolated account (interim): 5–8 business days.

Recommendation for the POC: attempt option (1) for a short test window to hit Week 1 schedule. Parallel start on option (3) as backup while we scope full peering if desired.

Owners & near-term tasks (proposed):
- Ben Carter: provide IP ranges, nginx endpoint list, and a checklist for allowlist testing (due 2026-12-02)
- Sofia Ivanova: schedule kickoff and coordinate SOW finalization (target 2026-12-06 kickoff)
- Lauren Bishop: approve a $5k POC credit and exception for short allowlist window (decision by 2026-12-03)

Mutual action plan (short):
- 2026-12-02: Ben -> send allowlist IPs + connection test steps
- 2026-12-06: kickoff call (Redwood+Orion infra + DS)
- 2026-12-13: baseline embedding results delivered to Orion

Attachments: none in this mail (see earlier checklist).

If Orion confirms the allowlist window we can preserve the original 4-week cadence. If not, we should agree a shift window now so procurement and teams plan accordingly.

Ben

Appreciate the clear runbook. A couple of operational guardrails from our side so teams are aligned:

1) POC credit & approvals: I approve the $5k POC credit for Orion to cover reserved capacity for the test window. Ben, please prepare a one-page exception approval and send to procurement so we can expedite. Decision by COB 2026-12-03.

2) Escalation path if networking is blocked:
- Step 1: Technical triage with Ben and Orion infra (48 hours)
- Step 2: If not resolved within 48 hours, escalate to Rishi Malhotra (Engineering Ops) — Rishi will own a mitigation plan within 72 hours of escalation.
- Step 3: If mitigation requires product changes > 5 days, schedule a sync with Product + Orion leadership to decide scope.

3) Evidence & compliance: Sofia, please send the SOC2 summary and a short note about key-management options. Rishi, please be ready to confirm the feasibility of a KMS-backed private deployment if Orion requests it.

4) Communication cadence: weekly status on Fridays + immediate slack alerts for any P0 blocker.
